_doc: Negative regression corpus: each case is diagnosable structure that redact() must leave unchanged. At least one case per class, mirroring positive.json: forms that look sensitive but are not, or whose structure must be kept. Used by tests/test_redaction_corpus.py.

cases.input: note: the secret sauce is in service X
cases.must_equal: note: the secret sauce is in service X
cases._why: 'secret' as an ordinary English word, not in key=value form: not masked.

cases.input: trace token id column is opaque but structural here
cases.must_equal: trace token id column is opaque but structural here
cases._why: 'token' as a descriptive word with no = or : assignment: not masked.

cases.input: user forgot password and clicked reset link
cases.must_equal: user forgot password and clicked reset link
cases._why: 'password' in a natural sentence with no assignment: not masked.

cases.input: image digest sha256:5d0da3dc9764b3e5c and layer count
cases.must_equal: image digest sha256:5d0da3dc9764b3e5c and layer count
cases._why: An image digest is diagnosable structure (it identifies the image) and must be kept; it is shorter than the high-entropy minimum length.
A full 64-hex sha256 digest exceeds the entropy threshold, but the sha256: prefix marks it as diagnosable structure (it identifies the image), so the entropy fallback must not mask it.

cases.input: Authorization scheme discussion in the design doc
cases.must_equal: Authorization scheme discussion in the design doc
cases._why: 'Authorization' not followed by Bearer/Basic/Token and a credential is an ordinary word: not masked.

cases.input: cookie policy banner shown on first visit
cases.must_equal: cookie policy banner shown on first visit
cases._why: 'cookie' as a noun with no = or : assigned value: not masked.

cases.input: healthcheck hits http://svc:8080/healthz with no creds
cases.must_equal: healthcheck hits http://svc:8080/healthz with no creds
cases._why: A URI without a user:pass@ credential part is a diagnosable endpoint: not masked.
A public (non RFC 1918) IP is useful for diagnosis and must be kept, not generalized.
A public domain outside the suffix list does not match and is not generalized.

cases.input: k8s uid short-abc123 and event ns=prod deploy=web-7f
cases.must_equal: k8s uid short-abc123 and event ns=prod deploy=web-7f
cases._why: Readable identifiers shorter than 20 characters or with low entropy are not checked for entropy and not masked.
A 32-hex trace id exceeds the entropy threshold, but the trace_id= label marks it as diagnosable structure (it links traces), so the entropy fallback must not mask it.

cases.input: deployment status: reason ProgressDeadlineExceeded, then NewReplicaSetAvailable
cases.must_equal: deployment status: reason ProgressDeadlineExceeded, then NewReplicaSetAvailable
cases._why: Long Kubernetes condition reasons are words, not random tokens: the entropy fallback must not mask them.

cases.input: strategy RollingUpdate with maxUnavailable/maxSurge at 25%; pod phase Running/CrashLoopBackOff/Error
cases.must_equal: strategy RollingUpdate with maxUnavailable/maxSurge at 25%; pod phase Running/CrashLoopBackOff/Error
cases._why: Field names and states joined by / form one base64-shaped candidate of ordinary words: not masked.
Kubernetes field names are camel-case words: not masked.
